# Switchboard

A terminal coding agent where the model is a slot, not a fixed property of the
tool. You configure a policy-ordered ladder of models, usually with lower-cost
targets near the bottom. Before each user turn, the deterministic router chooses
a feasible rung from request signals and that user-defined order.
Repeated tool calls, error spikes, new test failures, and hedging can propose a
move; round, feasibility, and budget gates decide whether it applies. Every
session is an append-only record that can be priced, replayed, and searched.
Free and open source (MIT), for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Version 1.21 adds crash-durable streamed output, read-only resume health,
validated seven-section compaction, transactional retry recovery, concrete
serving-target output caps, denial-first modal queuing, and staged subagent
workflows. The searchable workbench, deterministic model ladder, accounting,
trust model, extensions, and computer use remain. The line-oriented REPL and
headless mode remain deliberately smaller than the TUI.

Current sessions checkpoint streamed assistant text before it becomes visible,
show read-only resume health, withhold incomplete output from later provider
requests, and repair dangling tool calls without re-execution. Compaction uses
one validated seven-section handoff in the TUI and REPL. Clear, compact, fork,
retry, and race children remain undiscoverable until adoption publishes them;
transactional retry rolls files forward if that commit fails. Model context,
vision, serving-surface identity, and output allowance are checked from the
same concrete provider evidence used by the wire request and hard budget.

Commands run without a sandbox by default. Auto mode uses a configured low-cost
reviewer only under active verified confinement; host-direct, shared-loopback,
opaque, sensitive, external, and Windows commands remain human-approved. A
confined explicit full-network request can remain reviewable. Yolo mode runs
edits, commands, and external tools without permission prompts; explicit deny
rules and outbound secret checks still apply. Verified Seatbelt or bubblewrap
confinement is available on request.
